# API and data — the rules in force

Loaded with `apps/api`, `packages/contracts`, `packages/db`, `packages/crypto`, `packages/logger`. Each line names the record it comes from; open that record when the line is not enough. Which window is open and which records are in force is stated once, in [the ledger](../plan/README.md#the-window).

- **Functional style, no OOP** — No `class`, no `this`, no decorators, no DI framework. Every layer is `create<Module><Layer>(deps)` returning an `as const` object; types come from `ReturnType`. Third-party constructors are wrapped in `create*` functions. — [ADR-0009](../adr/0009-api-modular-layering.md) (modular API)
- **Layers** — `*.routes.ts` → `*.controller.ts` → `*.service.ts` → `*.repository.ts`. Services never import Express or SQL; repositories hold every Drizzle query; controllers read `req.valid`, call the service with `req.ctx` first, and answer through `respond.*`. — [ADR-0009](../adr/0009-api-modular-layering.md) (modular API)
- **Envelope** — Controllers use `respond.ok / created / list / noContent` and nothing else; `res.json` appears only inside the API's own `core/http`. — [ADR-0012](../adr/0012-response-envelope.md) (unified response envelope)
- **Errors** — One branded `AppError`, thrown through factories (`notFound()`, `forbidden()`, a module's `*.errors.ts`) and matched with `isAppError(e)` plus `e.code` — never `instanceof`, never a new error class. The API's `message` is developer-facing English and is never rendered by a client. The handler reports 5xx through the reporting seam and the response shape does not widen. — [ADR-0013](../adr/0013-error-model.md) (error model and HTTP status mapping) as carried by [ADR-0066](../adr/0066-infrastructure-seams.md)
- **Configuration** — `process.env` is read only in `apps/api/src/core/config`, `packages/db/src/tooling/env.ts`, `scripts/postman.mjs` and the API test harness. A new variable means a zod schema entry, an `.env.example` line and — when a task reads it — a `turbo.json` `env` entry. — [ADR-0004](../adr/0004-configuration-and-environment.md) (configuration and environment validation) as carried by [ADR-0059](../adr/0059-ci-containers-and-deployment.md)
- **Request context** — Services take `ctx: RequestContext` as their first parameter; `getContext()` belongs to infrastructure only. — [ADR-0010](../adr/0010-request-context.md) (request context object and propagation)
- **Validation** — Zod schemas live in `@repo/contracts` and are re-exported by `<module>.schemas.ts`; controllers read `req.valid.{params,query,body}` and nothing else; bodies are `.strict()`. — [ADR-0011](../adr/0011-middleware-pipeline.md) (middleware pipeline), [ADR-0023](../adr/0023-shared-contracts-package.md) (shared contracts package)
- **Auth and guards** — Two populations — `staff` and `user` — with separate tables and separate segments `/api/v1/{public,user,admin}`; `authenticate()` at router level and `authorize()` at the mount; `super_admin` bypasses staff role checks. Self-scoped resources carry no `authorize` because the subject is `ctx.principal`. An impersonated session is a `user` session minted by staff: it carries the actor, rotates without extending, and refuses credential operations. — [ADR-0017](../adr/0017-identity-model-populations-and-roles.md) (identity model) as carried by [ADR-0067](../adr/0067-organizations.md), [ADR-0019](../adr/0019-authorization-guards.md) (authorization guards), [ADR-0057](../adr/0057-impersonation-sessions.md) (impersonation sessions)
- **Database** — Schema in `packages/db/src/schema`; migrations are generated with `drizzle-kit generate` and committed, never pushed; the API never auto-migrates; seeds are idempotent. The API connects as the application role (`DATABASE_URL`) with table privileges and no DDL, and every tooling connection is the owner role (`DATABASE_URL_OWNER`, required with no fallback). — [ADR-0006](../adr/0006-database-postgres-drizzle.md) (postgreSQL with Drizzle ORM in a shared `@repo/db` package) as carried by [ADR-0061](../adr/0061-database-roles-and-append-only-enforcement.md), [ADR-0008](../adr/0008-database-migrations-and-seeding.md) (database migrations, setup and seeding) as carried by [ADR-0059](../adr/0059-ci-containers-and-deployment.md) and [ADR-0061](../adr/0061-database-roles-and-append-only-enforcement.md), [ADR-0061](../adr/0061-database-roles-and-append-only-enforcement.md) (database roles and append-only enforcement)
- **Append-only audit** — `audit_events` is append-only in the database as well as in the lint rule — a revoked grant and a `BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE` trigger — so retention is a reviewed migration and never a job. — [ADR-0058](../adr/0058-append-only-audit-log.md) (an append-only audit log) as carried by [ADR-0061](../adr/0061-database-roles-and-append-only-enforcement.md), [ADR-0061](../adr/0061-database-roles-and-append-only-enforcement.md) (database roles and append-only enforcement)
- **Per-population data** — Per-population data gets a table per population with a real foreign key rather than a discriminated table; `sessions` is the single exception and says why in place. — [ADR-0045](../adr/0045-user-settings.md) (user settings) as carried by [ADR-0053](../adr/0053-account-area.md), [ADR-0053](../adr/0053-account-area.md) (the account area)
- **List endpoints at scale** — One list-query language, its codec in `@repo/contracts`. `offset` has a ceiling and `count` is an optional flag: with `count=false` a repository skips the aggregate and returns `total: null`. Every sortable and searched column carries a covering index declaration, trigram indexes for search and btree for sorts. — [ADR-0014](../adr/0014-pagination-filtering-sorting.md) (pagination, filtering and sorting conventions) as carried by [ADR-0060](../adr/0060-list-endpoints-at-scale.md), [ADR-0060](../adr/0060-list-endpoints-at-scale.md) (list endpoints at scale)
- **Tenancy** — One database, one schema: every tenant-owned table carries `organization_id not null` and is indexed tenant-led, with no bare `(column, id)` pairs beside those composites. A repository over such a table takes the organization id as a required parameter; the sanctioned exception is a read scoped by the **principal** rather than by a tenant, named in its repository for what it is, and the hand-maintained `TENANT_OWNED_TABLES` list is what the enumeration test checks the roster against. Every path that creates a user creates their personal organization in the same transaction; staff are never members, and a non-member is answered `404` rather than `403`. — [ADR-0067](../adr/0067-organizations.md) (organizations)
- **Infrastructure seams** — Mail goes through the `MailSender` port in `core/mail` and never through a client a service imports; `GET /metrics` lives in `core/metrics` beside `/health`, above every limiter, labelled by route pattern and behind a token; the reporter in `core/reporting` fires on 5xx only and is given the request id, route, status and principal — never the body; the four limiters share one store, Redis when configured and memory otherwise, failing closed. All four are inert in a default clone. — [ADR-0066](../adr/0066-infrastructure-seams.md) (infrastructure seams)
- **Logging** — pino through `ctx.logger`; a fields object first and a short static message second; no `console.*`. — [ADR-0005](../adr/0005-logging.md) (structured logging with pino)
- **Contracts** — `@repo/contracts` depends on `zod` alone; an enum is defined there once and consumed by both `pgEnum` and zod. — [ADR-0023](../adr/0023-shared-contracts-package.md) (shared contracts package)
- **Tests** — Unit tests use fake repositories as plain objects; integration tests go through `createApp(buildContainer({ db: testDb }))` and supertest against the test database. Every new endpoint gets both, plus a Postman request. — [ADR-0021](../adr/0021-testing-strategy.md) (testing strategy)
- **Lint is the mechanical half** — `packages/config-eslint/api.js` already fails the build on classes, raw responses, `process.env` and layer-crossing imports. A rule a reviewer keeps repeating belongs there instead. — [ADR-0002](../adr/0002-monorepo-layout-and-tooling.md) (monorepo layout and tooling) as carried by [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md), [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) (frontend build and shared app composition)
